conditions: Loopback HTTPS Moto S3 emulator, synthetic bucket metadata and TLS SMTP capture; pinned application SDK; external sockets blocked; no hosted provider or actual recipient contacted.

tests.objective: Verified HTTPS upload, spooled download and size through the real adapter
Duplicate upload keeps original bytes and generates a distinct name
Anonymous wire request cannot read the private object
public metadata fails closed before writing an object
unavailable metadata fails closed before writing an object
Synthetic object backup/delete/restore preserves names, hashes and private cache policy
Actual TLS SMTP submission preserves the generated PDF attachment
SMTP rejection does not manufacture acceptance or retry
Interrupted acceptance is uncertain and does not automatically resend
